# Ascendus

> Ascendus is a technology consulting and implementation partner delivering SAP transformation, enterprise technology, and digital services to enterprises across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region.

Ascendus helps organizations modernize through SAP-led transformation, cloud and infrastructure, data and AI, cybersecurity, digital engineering, and customer experience services, with regional compliance and delivery expertise for the KSA/GCC market.

## Company

- [Who We Are](https://www.ascendus.sa/who-we-are): Company overview, principles, and delivery approach.
- [Careers](https://www.ascendus.sa/careers): Open roles and hiring process.
- [Contact](https://www.ascendus.sa/contact): Get in touch with Ascendus.
- [Book a Consultation](https://www.ascendus.sa/book-a-consultation): Schedule a call with the team.

## What We Do

- [Enterprise Transformation](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/enterprise-transformation): SAP-led enterprise transformation services.
- [SAP Transformation](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/enterprise-transformation/sap-transformation): SAP implementation and modernization.
- [Microsoft Services](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/enterprise-transformation/microsoft-services): Microsoft platform services.
- [Broader Technology Services](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/enterprise-transformation/broader-technology-services): Extended enterprise technology services.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/artificial-intelligence): AI strategy, deployment, and scaling.
- [Cloud & Infrastructure](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud migration and infrastructure services.
- [Data & Intelligence](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/data-intelligence): Data architecture, governance, and analytics.
- [Digital Engineering](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/digital-engineering): Custom software and API development.
- [Customer Experience](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/customer-experience): Experience design and customer journey services.
- [Experience Design](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/experience-design): UX research and design systems.
- [Cybersecurity & Digital Trust](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/cybersecurity-digital-trust): Security architecture, GRC, and identity management.
- [Intelligent Automation](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/intelligent-automation): Process automation services.
- [Managed Services](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/managed-services): Ongoing operations and support.
- [Business Advisory](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/business-advisory): Business and technology advisory services.
- [Innovation & Emerging Technologies](https://www.ascendus.sa/what-we-do/innovation-emerging-technologies): Emerging technology exploration and adoption.
